evidence: Hydatius, Chronicon: ad locum quī Portucale appellātur
Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Oporto: Portus Calle
Graesse, Orbis Latinus (1861), index s.v. Porto: Cale, Portus calis
terms.comment: Hydatius, in the fifth century, writes Portucale as one word; Graesse prints Portus Cale. A town takes no preposition: Portum Cale (to), Portū Cale (in, at, from).

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
